data.one_liner: Format Dart DateTime objects using standard date/time notations or relative time offsets.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility methods and DateTime extensions for formatting dates using standard notations or as relative time offsets (e.g., '5 minutes ago'). Includes various pre-defined formatting constants and supports custom abbreviations, precision levels, and rounding.
use_when: You need to format DateTime objects using standard date/time notations
You need human-readable relative time offsets like '5 minutes ago' or 'In 3 days'
avoid_when: You require robust, locale-aware internationalization for a wide range of human languages beyond English-style formatting
You only need native Dart DateTime capabilities without external formatting strings
strengths: Provides both utility classes and extension methods on DateTime
Rich set of formatting constants including American and European formats
Highly customizable relative time formatting with precision, rounding, and abbreviations
weaknesses: Limited localization documentation for languages outside English relative formats
No built-in date parsing mentioned, focuses purely on formatting
